info.name: CreatorConnect - E2E API Tests
info.description:
End-to-end API tests for CreatorConnect, executed through the API Gateway (single entry point).

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:8080).

Flow (run folders in order):
1. Auth   - register a CREATOR and a FREELANCER, login both, capture JWTs into collection variables.
2. Profile- create/read/update the creator profile, list the freelancer pool, security negatives.
3. Project- create two projects (one stays OPEN for hiring), read/update, lifecycle status transitions incl. 409.
4. Hiring - freelancer applies, creator accepts (project -> IN_PROGRESS via Feign), project -> COMPLETED, review flow, security negatives.
5. AI     - public status, discovery with the documented 502 LLM-failure contract (current OpenAI key has exhausted quota), auth negatives.

Re-runnable: every run uses a fresh emailSuffix so registrations never collide.
Expected status codes and response shapes are documented per request. No secrets are stored in this collection.

exec: // Fresh suffix per run so the collection is re-runnable.
pm.test('message is User registered successfully', function () { pm.expect(json.message).to.eql('User registered successfully'); });

request.description:
Registers a new CREATOR account.

Headers: Content-Type: application/json
Body: firstName, lastName, email (unique per run), password (8-64, upper+lower+digit+special), phone (optional), role

Expected: 201 CREATED with data.id (the platform userId).
Errors: 400 invalid payload · 409 email already exists.

Registers a new FREELANCER account.

Expected: 201 CREATED.
Errors: 400 invalid payload · 409 email already exists.

Authenticates the creator and issues a JWT.

Test script auto-saves {{jwtToken}} and {{userId}} into collection variables; every protected request in this collection reuses {{jwtToken}} via its Authorization header.

Expected: 200 OK, data.accessToken (JWT), data.userId.
Errors: 401 bad credentials.

Authenticates the freelancer and issues a JWT.

Test script auto-saves {{jwtFreelancer}} and {{freelancerUserId}}.

Expected: 200 OK.

exec: pm.test('invalid register payload returns 400', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(400); });
pm.test('error envelope has status 400 and a message', function () { pm.expect(json.status).to.eql(400); pm.expect(json.message).to.exist; });

exec: // The configured OPENAI_API_KEY has exhausted its quota (external account limit).
// Per the documented error contract the service must answer 502 with a generic message.
// If a valid key is configured later, the same test asserts the success shape.
pm.test('LLM quota failure -> 502 per contract', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(502); });
pm.test('502 error message is generic and client-safe', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('AI service is temporarily unavailable'); });

request.description:
Natural-language talent discovery. Requires a valid JWT. The AI Service fetches the talent pool from the Profile Service via OpenFeign (forwarding the caller's JWT) and asks the external LLM to rank it.

Current state: the configured OPENAI_API_KEY has exhausted its quota, so the documented 502 LLM-failure contract is expected (no fake results are ever produced). When a valid key is configured, a 200 with ranked results is expected.

Expected today: 502 BAD_GATEWAY, message 'AI service is temporarily unavailable'.
